summary: Nested linear membership turns two large lists into a quadratic tribute to wasted CPU.

findings.title: List membership makes the loop quadratic

evidence.quote:
for item in left:
        if item in right:

findings.consequence: At 100,000 entries, quadratic work can exhaust request latency and CPU budgets.
findings.fix: Convert right to a set once, then test membership against that set.
findings.test: Benchmark disjoint 100,000-item lists and assert near-linear scaling.
